## Feature Request

The tree switcher (`frontend/src/components/sidebar/DatabaseSelector.tsx`, in the sidebar settings) currently groups trees into just two sections: a single "Trees" group containing both owned and shared-with-you trees (differentiated only by a small Crown/Users icon per row), and a separate "Virtual views" group below it.

## Expected Behavior

Split the trees group into two: your own trees, and trees shared with you — similar to how virtual views already get their own section — so the dropdown reads, top to bottom: **Your trees → Shared with you → Virtual views**.

## Suggested approach

- In `DatabaseSelector.tsx`, partition `trees` (from `useTreeStore`) by `db.role === "owner"` vs not, and render two `SelectGroup`s (with a `SelectSeparator` between them, matching the existing separator before the virtual-views group) instead of one.
- Keep the existing Crown/Users icon per item too (or drop it now that grouping conveys the same info — worth a quick UX call, but keeping it is lower risk and keeps sort-independent scanability).
- Add new i18n keys for the two group labels (e.g. `your-trees-group`, `shared-trees-group`) in every locale, replacing/adjusting the current `trees-group` key in `frontend/src/i18n/locales/*`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Dropdown shows three ordered sections: your trees, shared trees, virtual views (sections with zero items are hidden, matching current virtual-views behavior)
- [ ] New group labels are translated in every locale
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `## [Unreleased]`

## Relevant Files

- `frontend/src/components/sidebar/DatabaseSelector.tsx`
- `frontend/src/hooks/useTreeStore.ts`
- `frontend/src/i18n/locales/*`

## Review: PR #803 — split tree switcher into "Your trees" / "Shared with you"

**Overview**: Implements #802 cleanly — `DatabaseSelector.tsx` now filters `trees` into `ownedTrees`/`sharedTrees`, renders two conditionally-visible `SelectGroup`s in place of the old single group, and fixes separator placement so a `SelectSeparator` only appears when a preceding section actually rendered. i18n keys, CHANGELOG entry, and a new test file (component previously had none) round it out.

**Correctness**
- Separator logic is sound: shared group's leading separator gated on `ownedTrees.length > 0`, virtual-views separator gated on `trees.length > 0` — every zero-item section stays fully hidden with no stray separators, matching the acceptance criteria.
- `handleDatabaseChange` still does `[...trees, ...virtualViews].find(...)` — correct, since `ownedTrees`/`sharedTrees` are just filtered views of the same `trees` array, not a new data source.
- Trees with `role` undefined fall into `sharedTrees` (via `!== "owner"`) — same fallback behavior as the original ternary, so no regression.

**Style/conventions**
- Follows existing patterns (mirrors the virtual-views conditional-group structure).
- i18n: both locales fully covered (only `en`/`de` exist in this repo); `shared-trees-group` intentionally duplicates the `shared` icon-label string value, which is fine — the issue asked for a distinct key, not a distinct display string.
- Caught two pre-existing/introduced prettier violations locally (`SelectTrigger` line wrap, test file object literal) and pushed a follow-up formatting commit — file is now prettier-clean.

**Test coverage**
- New `DatabaseSelector.test.tsx` covers: both groups showing, shared-hidden-when-empty, owned-hidden-when-empty, and virtual-views coexisting with both tree groups. Mocks `useTreeStore`/`useUnsavedChangesStore` as selector-hooks (matches existing codebase mocking pattern), forces `en` locale for deterministic assertions, and polyfills `hasPointerCapture`/`scrollIntoView` for Radix Select in jsdom.

**Risks**: none significant — small, self-contained, always-on UI change with no backend/data-model impact.
